dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About "The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku"...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: According to the loan records, this was borrowed by an envoy from Narukami Island. I doubt we're getting this one back, honestly.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: I think he said that he'd go back and turn this into a novel or something like that.
